sections.title: MCS Capstone Research III & Seminar
sections.description: MCS Capstone Research III & Seminar. Final course in MCS Capstone research series. The MCS Capstone research course culminates the research project requirement for graduation from the Master of Chemical Sciences program. The students will work with their Research Advisor to complete and present the Capstone Final Research Paper, Seminar & Poster. This course is usually taken in the Spring to give the students dedicated time to finish research and communicate their research. The Capstone Research is to be scholarly in scope, well-researched, organized and professional, and that contributes to the knowledge base or improves practice in the chemical sciences.
